info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-List Education Enrollments Status-v4-spec
info.description: The Education Enrollments Status API provides real-time information on the status of student enrollments within educational programs. Developers can use this endpoint to retrieve detailed status updates for various enrollments, which is crucial for monitoring progress and operational efficiency. Typical consumers include educational institutions and administrative staff who manage student information systems. This API facilitates informed decision-making by enabling direct access to enrollment status data, offering a streamlined approach to handling educational records.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of enrollments. You can use this information to check whether a specific enrollment is active, pending, or completed. Make sure to append any necessary query parameters to filter the results as per your needs.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the enrollment status. It should contain the necessary parameters required for querying the status of enrollments.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current enrollment status.
